messages:
Rae: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we sketched a short list of missing tests/evals that blocked root-cause validation. need owners and realistic timelines.
Jordan: sharing the list now, thanks. can we prioritize anything that prevents regressions from reaching prod?
Rae: Yup. Priority heuristic: customer-impacting regressions first, then low-effort coverage gaps. 
Rae: Items: 1) prompt-set for request-resume/fallback paths (edge short-circuit prompts) 2) regression for KV-eviction + long-context combos 3) load test for small-batch-high-concurrency (burst) 4) short chaos drill that simulates intermittent shard restarts 5) integration test to verify prefix/KV cache warm-start after failover.
Aisha: I can take the KV-eviction regression (2). estimate 3 days to write cases + 2 days to automate in the regression runner. target: 2024-07-05.
Jordan: I'll own the prompt-set (1). need to assemble ~30 examples and a small scoring eval. target: 2024-06-28.
Tom: I can take the chaos drill (4). want to coordinate with Eng-SRE for safe window. propose a one-hour drill on a staging fleet. target: 2024-07-12.
Priya: For the load test (3) — I'd prefer we parameterize the existing load harness (burst config) rather than add a separate job. I can deliver a PR to the harness + a template config. target: 2024-07-01.
Rae: Thanks. for (5) cache warm-start integration test, who has the local infra knowledge?
Tom: I can help with infra bits but that'll be a collab with Aisha since it ties to KV behaviour. suggest a joint owner: Aisha (lead) + Tom (infra). target: 2024-07-08.
Jordan: I pushed a doc outline: https://redwood.internal/docs/pm/postmortem-543 — contains examples and failure traces to seed the prompt-set.
Aisha: adding test vectors from the traces now. will also add a short flaky-case guard so CI doesn't block on non-deterministic cache timing.
Rae: Action items (short):
  - A1: Prompt-set & scoring harness — owner: Jordan — due: 2024-06-28 — create PR + attach eval outputs.
  - A2: KV-eviction regression + automation — owner: Aisha — due: 2024-07-05 — include fixture that simulates eviction.
  - A3: Burst load template for small-batch-high-concurrency — owner: Priya — due: 2024-07-01 — add to load-harness repo.
  - A4: Chaos drill runbook + staging run — owner: Tom — due: 2024-07-12 — coordinate with Eng-SRE and notify customers if any smoke alerts possible.
  - A5: Cache warm-start integration test — owners: Aisha (lead) + Tom (infra) — due: 2024-07-08.
Jordan: I'll open the prompt-set PR today and assign reviewers.
Priya: I'll draft the load template and a brief runbook for running in perf-ci.
infra-bot: Scheduled maintenance window requested: 2024-07-11T02:00-03:00 UTC for staging cluster. React with :thumbsup: to approve.
Tom: noted — will align chaos drill to avoid staging window conflict.
Rae: Can we add automated regression gating for high-severity prompts? suggestion: if new eval drops >5% for any critical prompt, block the rollout and auto-open a remediation ticket.
Jordan: Agree. we can wire eval alerts to the rollout pipeline (small RFC needed). I'll draft a quick RFC.
Priya: For the load tests, also logging request-level metrics that surfaced in the incident (latency tail, queue length). That data helps correlate regressions.
Aisha: quick question: do we use synthetic or recorded traces for the prompt-set? recorded traces look best for edge cases.
Jordan: prefer recorded + anonymized; augment with synthetic variations to increase coverage.
Rae: Great. owners, please add the action items to the postmortem board and tag "remediation" + "evals". I'll do a 1:1 check-in next Tue to review progress.
onchalant reaction: :eyes: (mostly emoji).
onchalant: tiny note — keep tests reasonably small, don't blow up CI runtime. prioritize unit-level validation first, then full-regression runs on schedule.
onchalant: (that was Rae whispering)
oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up review meeting 2024-06-25 15:00 UTC — attendees: Rae, Jordan, Aisha, Priya, Tom.
Aisha: I'll update the board now and add estimated PR links.
Jordan: PR opened: https://git.redwood/repo/evals/pull/412 — prompt-set draft. reviewers: Rae, Priya.
Priya: PR opened for load harness template: https://git.redwood/repo/perf/pull/88 — allotting a small perf job slot for validation.
Tom: added chaos runbook draft in the playbooks repo: https://git.redwood/playbooks/chaos/kv-shard-restart.md — requesting Eng-SRE review.
Rae: Thanks all. if anything slips, ping me directly. we'll escalate to Eng-Platform if infra approvals block. :thumbsup:
